clustering_comparison.timer: time.perf_counter inside the same container process

clock_note: Job created_at/updated_at use Docker wall time. Host request times use perf_counter; observed clock disagreement makes those measurements unsuitable for comparison. The before/after clustering comparison uses the same process and monotonic timer in the same Docker container, sequentially, with no test suites or image builds running.
request_timing_scope: run_analysis through terminal job polling, excludes database retrieval, upload, client plot rendering and response generation
clustering_timing_scope: PCA, full 42-trial DBSCAN search, silhouette scoring, terms, representative examples and 3D coordinates; excludes materialization and BERTopic
